_comment: The ROM repeats a small library of leaf routines in many banks. Each entry names one canonical routine; tools/disasm_all.py gives every function entry whose bytes are identical the name 'Name_BankBB' (E-0027). The canonical routine must contain no call, jump or restart, so identical bytes behave identically in every bank. Two entries may share a name when the bytes differ but the behaviour is the same; the bank suffix keeps names unique. 'note' gives inputs, outputs and what is clobbered, from a complete reading of the instructions.

families.name: BGMapAddressAtScroll
families.note: HL = vBGMap0 + (hScrollY & $F8) * 4 + hScrollX / 8, the BG map entry for pixel (hScrollX, hScrollY); clobbers A, DE

families.name: BGMapAddressAtScroll
families.note: HL = $9800 + (hScrollY & $F8) * 4 + hScrollX / 8, the BG map entry for pixel (hScrollX, hScrollY); clobbers A, DE

families.name: StoreBAtWordTableEntry
families.note: HL = table of 16-bit addresses, A = index: stores B at the address in entry A; keeps BC; clobbers A, DE, HL

families.name: StoreBAtWordTableEntry
families.note: HL = table of 16-bit addresses, A = index: stores B at the address in entry A; keeps BC; clobbers A, DE, HL

families.name: AddDoubleAToHL
families.note: HL += 2 * A (A is doubled in 8 bits first, so it wraps above $7F); clobbers A

families.name: StepWC921Counter
families.note: wC921 += 1; if it now equals B it is reset to 0 and carry is set, else carry is clear; returns A = 0 either way

families.name: ReadWDA53Indexed
families.note: A = the byte at wDA53 + A; clobbers HL

families.name: ReadByteAtHLPlus4APlus3C
families.note: A = [HL + 4 * A + 3 * C], the offset computed in 8 bits; clobbers HL

families.name: StoreWordAtDEPlus2C
families.note: DE += 2 * C; copies the word at HL to [DE]; HL += 2, DE ends on the second byte written

families.name: StoreByteAtDEPlusC
families.note: DE += C; copies the byte at HL to [DE]; HL += 1

families.name: ClearBit2AtHL
families.note: [HL] &= $FB; clobbers A

families.name: SetBit1AtHL
families.note: [HL] |= $02; clobbers A

families.name: ClearBit1AtHL
families.note: [HL] &= $FD; clobbers A

families.name: SetBit2OfWD095Indexed
families.note: Sets bit 2 of the byte at wD095 + A; keeps HL; clobbers A

families.name: SetBit0OfWD095Indexed
families.note: Sets bit 0 of the byte at wD095 + A; keeps HL; clobbers A

families.name: SetBit1OfWD095Indexed
families.note: Sets bit 1 of the byte at wD095 + A; keeps HL; clobbers A

families.name: FillWC278WithC3
families.note: Fills the $160 bytes at wC278 with $C3; clobbers A, BC, HL

families.name: CopyTileBytesToVRAM
families.note: Copies 16 bytes from [HL] to [DE]; each byte is written with interrupts off after waiting for rSTAT bit 1 to clear; clobbers A, C; HL and DE advance

families.name: CopyTileBytesToVRAM
families.note: Copies 16 bytes from [HL] to [DE]; each byte is written with interrupts off after waiting for rSTAT bit 1 to clear; clobbers A; HL and DE advance

families.name: CopyLow3BitsToWRAMBank2
families.note: With rSVBK = 2, copies BC bytes from [DE] to [HL], each ANDed with $07; then rSVBK = 0

families.name: CopyLow3BitsToWRAMBank2
families.note: With rSVBK = 2, copies BC bytes from [DE] to [HL], each ANDed with $07; then rSVBK = 0

families.name: StoreC5BEC6AtHLStride2
families.note: [HL] = $C5, [HL+2] = $BE, [HL+4] = $C6; HL ends at HL+4; clobbers A

families.name: AddWordAtHLToBC
families.note: BC += the word at [HL]; HL += 2; clobbers A

families.name: NextBGMapColumn
families.note: L = (L & $E0) | ((L + 1) & $1F): moves HL one entry right inside its 32-entry BG map row, wrapping at the row end; keeps AF

families.name: CopyShortStringToWC8CF
families.note: Copies up to 10 bytes from [HL] to wC8CF, stopping at a $F0 byte, then stores a $F0 terminator

families.name: BuildOamFromSpriteTable
families.note: DE = two-level table; entries are chosen by hSpriteSetIndex and hSpriteSubIndex; writes 4-byte OAM entries at $C000 + 4 * hOamNextEntry (Y = hSpriteOriginY + b + $10, X = hSpriteOriginX + b + 8, tile += hSpriteTileOffset, flags ^= hSpriteAttrXor) until a $80 byte or hOamNextEntry reaches $28 (40 entries)

families.name: AddWordAtHLToDE
families.note: DE += the word at [HL]; HL += 1 (ends on the high byte); clobbers A

families.name: CopyRectTo20ByteRows
families.note: Copies a rectangle of B bytes by C rows from [DE] to [HL], rows 20 ($14) bytes apart; on CGB it then zero-fills the same-shaped rectangle at HL + $0E68 with rSVBK = 2 and restores rSVBK = 0

families.name: CopyRectTo20ByteRows
families.note: Copies a rectangle of B bytes by C rows from [DE] to [HL], rows 20 ($14) bytes apart; on CGB it then zero-fills the same-shaped rectangle at HL + $0E68 with rSVBK = 2 and restores rSVBK = 0

families.name: HLToWD814EntryOfWD8A5
families.note: HL = wD814 + 9 * [wD8A5] (AddAx9ToHL); A = [wD8A5]

families.name: ClearScreenTileBuffer
families.note: fills the $240 bytes at wScreenTileBuffer with $C3

families.name: PersonalityIndexOfSlot
families.note: A = slot 0-7: returns A = 9 * g(wD968[A]) + 3 * g(wD970[A]) + g(wD978[A]) with g(v) = 0 for v >= $C0, 1 for v >= $40, else 2 (the same index PersonalityIndexOfRecord builds from a save record; E-0031); HL and BC are kept

families.name: CopyBytesDEToHL
families.note: DE = source, HL = destination, BC = count: copies BC bytes (BC = 0 copies 65536); DE and HL end past the copy; clobbers A, BC = 0 (E-0064)

families.name: CopyBBytesDEToHL
families.note: DE = source, HL = destination, B = count: copies B bytes (B = 0 copies 256); DE and HL end past the copy; clobbers A, B = 0 (E-0064)

families.name: ActorOnLocalSide
families.note: carry set when wBattleActor < 4 (slots 0-3); when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set the test is reversed (carry set when wBattleActor >= 4). Which side is local is inferred from the reversal, not checked (E-0064)

families.name: TargetOnLocalSide
families.note: carry set when wBattleTarget < 4 (slots 0-3); when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set the test is reversed (carry set when wBattleTarget >= 4) (E-0064)

families.name: RotateDirectionAtDEEvery32
families.note: when wScriptParam0 & $1F = 0: [DE] = ([DE] + 1) & 3, the next of four directions; otherwise returns with A = wScriptParam0 & $1F (E-0064)

families.name: ReadTileBuffer2x2AtPixel
families.note: B = X pixel, C = Y pixel: HL = wScreenTileBuffer + 20 * (C / 8) + B / 8 (rows of 20 entries); copies the 2 x 2 entries there to wC910, wC911 (top row) and wC912, wC913 (bottom row); HL ends on the bottom-right entry (E-0064)

families.name: SetMenuRowsForPage
families.note: when wMenuPage & $0F = wC0A7 - 1 (the last page): wMenuRowCount = wMenuLastPageRows and the cursor row wC46E is clamped below it; otherwise wMenuRowCount = 4; then clears bit 7 of wMenuPage (E-0064)

families.name: BGTileUnderPointIsHFFBA
families.note: DE = address of an X byte with its Y byte at DE - 1 (screen coordinates): HL = the $9800 BG map entry under (X + hScrollX - 4, Y + hScrollY - 12), rows wrapping inside the map; reads it after rSTAT bit 1 clears (interrupts off) and compares with hFFBA: Z set when equal, A = the tile; BC, HL kept (E-0065)

families.name: CopyRectToStride32
families.note: DE = source (rows packed), HL = destination with rows 32 bytes apart, B = width, C = rows: copies a B x C rectangle; DE ends past the source, HL at the start of the row below; B kept, C = 0 (E-0065)

families.name: ReadScreenBufferRectHeader
families.note: reads a 4-byte header at HL (word offset, width, rows): returns HL = wScreenTileBuffer + offset, B = width, C = rows, DE = the byte after the header (E-0065)

families.name: CopyRecordRectToScreenBuffer
families.note: HL = header (word offset, width, rows) followed by the tile bytes: copies the rectangle into wScreenTileBuffer + offset with rows 32 bytes apart (the same steps as ReadScreenBufferRectHeader then CopyRectToStride32) (E-0065)

families.name: ReadWordTableEntry
families.note: HL = table of words, A = index: HL = the word at HL + 2 * A (A is doubled in 8 bits, so it wraps above $7F); A = its low byte (E-0065)

families.name: AddAToWordAtHL
families.note: the word at HL += A (unsigned); HL ends on the high byte; clobbers A (E-0065)

families.name: FillBBytesAtHL
families.note: stores A in B bytes from HL (B = 0 fills 256); HL ends past the fill, B = 0 (E-0065)

families.name: StoreHFFC8WordAtHL
families.note: stores hFFC8 then hFFC9 at HL; HL += 2; clobbers A (E-0065)

families.name: FindByteAtHLInEightAtDE
families.note: searches the 8 bytes from DE for the byte at HL: Z set and DE on the match when found; otherwise B = 1, Z clear and DE 8 past the start (E-0065)

families.name: CountTableBytesAtOrBelowA
families.note: HL = ascending table of thresholds: C = A = the number of leading bytes that are <= A (the index of the first byte above A); HL ends on that byte. The table must contain a byte above A (E-0065)

families.name: CopyWD01ARecordToHL
families.note: copies the 27 ($1B) bytes at wD01A to HL; HL ends past the copy; clobbers A, B, DE (E-0065)

families.name: CopyBytesWithChecksum
families.note: HL = source, DE = destination, BC = count: copies BC bytes and adds each one to the 16-bit sum in hFFC8/hFFC9; clobbers A, BC = 0 (E-0065)

families.name: WDA77EntryHasBits2And3
families.note: C = index: Z set when bits 2 and 3 are both set in the byte at wDA77 + 7 * C (7-byte entries); A = that byte & $0C; HL points at it (E-0065)
